visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of an Olive Young store exterior at night, featuring bright green neon signage and glass doors. Large digital screens display cosmetic advertisements. (2) A close-up view of a large shopping bag overflowing with various boxed makeup products is shown. A male creator with styled brown hair appears in a circular inset at the bottom left, gesturing towards the bag. (3) The camera focuses on retail shelves displaying 3CE makeup palettes, followed by a hand holding a pink 3CE palette with a 'TRY ME' sticker. The background shows blurred store aisles. (4) A hand holds up a wakemake brand cushion compact featuring a cartoon dog character wearing sunglasses. The packaging is white and cream-colored. (5) Several wakemake products are showcased, including a 16-color eyeshadow palette, a peach-toned blush, and a pink-toned multi-use palette, all held in a hand against a store background. (6) The scene shifts to dasique products; a hand picks up a pink, flower-shaped lip balm container and opens it to reveal a glossy red product. A 4-color blush palette is then displayed. (7) CLIO brand products with Toy Story illustrations are shown, including an eyeshadow palette featuring Bo Peep. Several lip crayons are swatched on the back of a hand, showing various shades of red and nude. (8) An espoir eyeshadow palette with Disney characters Mickey and Minnie Mouse as DJs is showcased, followed by rom&nd blushes and eyeshadow palettes with coastal-themed illustrations. (9) A circular eglips eye palette with six neutral shades is displayed close-up. (10) The final shot returns to the shopping bag being held, with products being placed inside near a checkout counter.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop BGM. A male narrator introduces the video with a cheerful, high-arousal tone. A bright 'pop' sound effect triggers as the first product is mentioned. (2) As the narrator lists the 3CE and wakemake products, brief 'whoosh' sound effects punctuate each scene transition. The speech rate is fast and energetic, with clear articulation. (3) A 'ding' sound effect occurs when the dasique lip jelly is opened. The BGM remains consistent with a strong 4/4 electronic beat. (4) The narrator's pitch rises with excitement when describing the CLIO Toy Story and espoir Disney collaborations. Subtle plastic rustling noises can be heard underneath the voice as items are handled. (5) Each new brand (rom&nd, eglips) is introduced with a quick 'pop' sound effect. The BGM maintains its bright, synth-heavy texture throughout. (6) The video concludes with the narrator inviting viewers to comment, accompanied by a final 'ding' sound effect and the BGM fading out quickly. The overall acoustic environment is clean, resembling a studio-produced voice-over layered with stock music and SFX.
